photometry_validation.method: Four-band constrained positive smooth f_nu continuum; integrated SDSS2010 input and DECam2014 output response curves, 10A quadrature. Not a stellar-population template or dust model. Sersic n1/n4 profile proxy with Re=.75 Rhalf3D; 1arcsec Gaussian seeing and .75arcsec aperture radius.

limitations: No dust, epoch evolution, measured SED or light profile, blend flux, imaging masks/quality, Gaia star separation, fiber assignment or spectroscopic success simulation. Actual desitarget photometric cuts only; all rows assumed real galaxies. Smooth griz continuum extrapolates below g for observed g at z>.2. Fiber sizes are proxies. No P12A validation.
